Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed. We'd like to schedule an onsite Proof‑of‑Concept at Redwood HQ for a 6–8 person Orbis delegation (engineering + security) to run through a half‑day integration and performance check. Target week for us is May 22–25; ideal day is the 23rd.

A few asks up front:
- We need a private meeting room with dual HDMI + room mic/USB audio for hybrid attendees.
- Our security lead will need to submit an information security questionnaire and execute an NDA before access.
- Any badging guest instructions and parking passes would help (we have one EV).

Can you confirm availability and next steps (forms, contacts, preferred times)? Happy to sign NDA electronically.

Best,
